requirements.requirement: | functional | The system shall acquire telemetry data from at least 3 sensor channels simultaneously.
| functional | The system shall timestamp every acquired sample with a system time reference accurate to +/- 1 ms.
| functional | The system shall buffer at least 10000 samples per channel before flow control is applied.
| functional | The system shall record an engineering log with a minimum depth of 6 months of mission operations.
| non_functional | The system shall sustain a sample ingestion rate of at least 100 Hz per channel.
| non_functional | The system shall restrict access to acquisition controls to authenticated operators only.
| non_functional | The system shall complete a software restart in less than 30 seconds after a fault.
is added to require automatic fault recovery within 30 seconds, in addition to REQ-0009.

requirements.requirement: | interface | The ground segment interface shall transmit telemetry sample envelopes as defined in api.proto (message TelemetrySample).
| interface | The acquisition command interface shall accept a StartCommand message to begin acquisition.
| interface | The health reporting interface shall expose an MTBF estimate as defined in api.proto (message HealthReport).
| interface | The sensor interface shall provide a raw sample stream at the configured sample rate.
| functional | The system shall expose acquired samples through a REST interface to the ground segment.
